items.title: São Francisco de Paula (RS) Services procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Dec 2 #7
items.en_title: São Francisco de Paula (RS) Services procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Dec 2 #7
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in São Francisco de Paula (RS) is procuring professional or outsourced services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 1,745,799.60; proposals close Dec 2, 17:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
